================================================================================
                         WORKFLOW WRITING GUIDE
================================================================================

Step-by-step checklist for creating GitHub Actions workflows.

================================================================================
                         STEP 1: NAME & TRIGGER
================================================================================

name: "{Env} - {What it does}"

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - {branch}
    paths:
      - 'terraform/{env}/{path}/**'
      - '.github/workflows/{this-file}.yml'

  workflow_dispatch:

Checklist:
├── Name describes environment + action
├── Branch matches environment (dev/prod)
├── Paths point to correct Terraform folder
├── Include workflow file itself in paths
└── Add workflow_dispatch for manual trigger

================================================================================
                         STEP 2: PERMISSIONS
================================================================================

permissions:
  id-token: write   # For OIDC
  contents: read    # For checkout

Checklist:
└── Always include both for OIDC workflows

================================================================================
                         STEP 3: ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES
================================================================================

env:
  ENVIRONMENT: {env}
  TF_WORKING_DIR: terraform/{env}/{path}

Checklist:
├── ENVIRONMENT matches branch (dev/prod)
└── TF_WORKING_DIR matches paths trigger

================================================================================
                         STEP 4: JOB SETUP
================================================================================

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: "Display Name"
    runs-on: macOS
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || vars.{RESOURCE}_{ENV}_LOCKED != 'true' }}

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ env.TF_WORKING_DIR }}

Checklist:
├── runs-on: macOS (your runner)
├── Add lock variable check in if:
├── Set defaults.run.working-directory
└── Create lock variable in GitHub Settings if needed

================================================================================
                         STEP 5: CHECKOUT
================================================================================

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

Checklist:
└── Always first step

================================================================================
                         STEP 6: AWS AUTHENTICATION
================================================================================

      - name: Configure AWS Credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::${{ vars.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_{ENV} }}:role/GitHubActions-{RoleName}-${{ env.ENVIRONMENT }}
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}

Checklist:
├── Use correct AWS_ACCOUNT_ID variable (DEV/PROD)
├── Use correct IAM role name
└── Double colon after iam:: in ARN

================================================================================
                         STEP 7: FETCH SECRETS (IF NEEDED)
================================================================================

      - name: Fetch Secrets
        run: |
          SECRET=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
            --secret-id {env}/path/to/secret \
            --query SecretString --output text)

          # Mask before use
          echo "::add-mask::${SECRET}"

          # Set as TF_VAR
          echo "TF_VAR_variable_name=${SECRET}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

Checklist:
├── Correct secret path in Secrets Manager
├── Mask ALL secrets with ::add-mask::
└── Use TF_VAR_ prefix for Terraform variables

================================================================================
                         STEP 8: TERRAFORM STEPS
================================================================================

      - name: Terraform Init
        run: terraform init

      - name: Terraform Plan
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: terraform plan -out=tfplan

      - name: Lock Cleanup Instructions
        if: failure() || cancelled()
        run: |
          echo "State may be locked. Check DynamoDB."

      - name: Review Window
        run: |
          echo "Review window - 3 minutes"
          sleep 180

      - name: Terraform Apply
        run: terraform apply -auto-approve tfplan

Checklist:
├── Add timeout-minutes to plan
├── Save plan to file (-out=tfplan)
├── Add lock cleanup on failure
├── Add review window if needed
└── Apply uses saved plan file

================================================================================
                         COMMON MISTAKES
================================================================================

Mistake                          │ Fix
─────────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────
arn:aws:iam:${{                  │ arn:aws:iam::${{ (double colon)
canceled                         │ cancelled (British spelling)
{{ vars.NAME }}                  │ ${{ vars.NAME }} (missing $)
Wrong indentation                │ uses: and with: indent under - name:
Forgot to mask secrets           │ Always ::add-mask:: before using

================================================================================
                         QUICK REFERENCE
================================================================================

Order:
name → on → permissions → env → jobs → defaults → steps

Steps:
checkout → aws auth → fetch secrets → tf init → tf plan → review → tf apply

================================================================================
